source: Nitro matches the {0} of a server middleware case-sensitively. Unless {1} is {2}, a middleware registered for {3} with {4} or {5} does not run for {6} or {7}, but the page router still renders the pages at {8} and {9}. Setting {10} to {11} covers case variants, but not encoded slashes: a middleware registered for {12} does not run for {13}, while a catch-all page receives the decoded param {14}. Server middleware is not a reliable way to protect pages. Check access in the server route or API that returns the protected data.
